desc:
COMPACT HIGH-PERFORMANCE LOW BACK PRESSURE SUPPRESSOR

The Tisha suppressors represent a breakthrough in compact suppression technology, offering low back pressure, and high muzzle blast suppression in a compact 4.1in K-can suppressor package.

The Tisha punches above its class, outperforming many full-size suppressors in sound reduction, and back pressure.

The Inconel 30 Cal Tisha is the perfect for your AK, or 300 Blackout AR platform. Exceptional performance from a compact suppressor

Material: 718 Inconel

Weight: 15 Oz (no mount)

Overall Length: 4.1 inches (no mount)

Length Added: 3.7 Inches added to barrel length with the included direct thread mount (assuming a 0.7-inch barrel thread depthWill fit muzzle devices

Muzzle device compatibility: Will fit mounting systems protruding 1.5″ or less from the back of the suppressor

Calibers: 7.62mm, and other smaller calibers

Performance: The back pressure and Sound Performance Meet or exceed the Titanium 5.56 Tisha

Barrel Length Restriction: Not rated for barrel’s shorter than 8” inches when used with FRT or Full-Auto. No barrel length restriction for subsonic ammunition

Rated for all .30 caliber firearms 300RUM and below

Fully compatible with 1.375×24 hubs, the Inconel Tisha ships complete with a 5/8-24 Direct Thread Mount. (The Inconel Tisha is out lasting muzzle devices in hard use testing)

US Registered Patent Number: 12613072B12, 5 Additional Patents Pending
